items.verbatim: WEDC Tax Credit under the Business Development Tax Credit program, awarded 2025-09-22 to a recipient in City of Janesville, Rock County. Industry: Manufacturing (NAICS 311340). Award amount: $215,000. Planned project cost: $12,375,681. Planned capital investment: $12,375,681. Deliverables: Capital I
